references.text: Lot uses almost identical words when he goes out to the men of Sodom and begs them not to commit this wicked act, offering his daughters instead.
Both texts deal with hospitality being threatened by the men of the city who intend to abuse the guests.
The word 'nebalah' (shameful deed) is used in Israel to refer to serious sexual sins.
The same expression 'nebalah' is used regarding Shechem's rape of Dinah, describing a shameful act in Israel.
Later in the story, this event is referred to as 'nebalah' - a shameful deed committed in Israel.
Tamar uses the same expression 'nebalah' when she warns Amnon against raping her.
